violet: quick heads-up  splitting "Usage tiers" into two pages (metering + pricing). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1124 — need eyes on SDK snippets and dashboard links.
sam: link?
violet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1124/files
sam: small nits: JS snippet uses `client.oldUsage.send()` (deprecated)  change to `client.usage.report()`. also avoid raw grafana IDs in public docs.
docbot: lint queued: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1124  will fail for trailing spaces in fenced blocks.
violet: I'll replace panel ids with `{{dashboard:usage_overview}}` tokens and add a deprecated banner for legacy snippets.
ops-infra: please file an ops ticket if you need a new token mapping; we'll add a redirect.
sam: add explicit 429 example and a tiny backoff snippet for docs-tests:
```
for (let i=0;i<3;i++){
  const r = await client.usage.report(payload)
  if (r.status===429) await sleep((parseInt(r.headers['retry-after']||'1')*(2**i))*1000)
  else break
}
```
violet: added checklist in PR description (snippet updates, tokenized links, 429 example, docs-test, i18n markers). ci passed after whitespace fix. staging preview looks good. merging after one more approve.
docbot: staging deploy: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/usage/tiers — preview OK.
violet: merged. adding a short release-note blurb and closing thread.
